doh.help: Sends the router's DNS lookups encrypted to a DNS-over-HTTPS resolver. dnsmasq keeps answering the network and forwards to the local proxy instances.
doh.forcing: DNS of the LAN redirected to the router
doh.dnsmasq_own: dnsmasq uses its own upstream servers.
doh.started.enable: The proxy starts now and at every boot.
doh.started.disable: The proxy is stopped and no longer starts at boot.
doh.resolvers_help: Each resolver runs as its own local proxy instance; dnsmasq uses all of them.
doh.bootstrap_help: Comma-separated addresses that resolve the resolver's host name at start.
doh.bootstrap_invalid: Enter IP addresses separated by commas.
doh.port_help: Empty: the next free one from 5053.
doh.ca_file_help: Only for a resolver with a certificate from a private CA: a PEM file on the router.
doh.dnsmasq_help: While the proxy runs, dnsmasq forwards only to it; stopping the proxy restores the previous servers.
doh.force_dns_help: LAN clients that ask another DNS server on port 53 are answered by the router; DNS over TLS (port 853) is blocked.
doh.canary_icloud_help: Answers Apple's canary domains so devices keep using the router's DNS.
doh.canary_mozilla: Disable Firefox's own DNS over HTTPS
doh.canary_mozilla_help: Answers Mozilla's canary domain so Firefox keeps using the router's DNS.
